title: Northgate Optical Frame Restocking Percentage Schedule
content:
| Calendar days from the order date to the cancellation | Frame restocking percentage |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | 5 percent |
| 4 to 14 | 10 percent |
| 15 or more | 15 percent |

**Northgate Optical frame restocking percentage.** The frame restocking percentage is 5 percent when the job is cancelled no more than 3 calendar days after its order date, 10 percent when it is cancelled 4 to 14 calendar days after it, and 15 percent when it is cancelled later.

**Counting the days.** The days are calendar days after the eyewear job's order date, up to the day of the cancellation, when the refund is worked out. A job cancelled on its order date is cancelled 0 days after it.

### Edges of the schedule (hypothetical job ordered on 2 June 2025)

| Cancelled on | Days after the order date | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 5 June 2025 | 3 | 5 percent |
| 6 June 2025 | 4 | 10 percent |
| 16 June 2025 | 14 | 10 percent |
| 17 June 2025 | 15 | 15 percent |

Applied to a net frame charge of 180.00 (hypothetical), the three percentages give 9.00, 18.00 and 27.00.
